about: The people's site keys on PrompTugal.news (public halves only), at Dinis Cruz's word (6 November 2026: "add my key to this site, the keys of this site, so that I can drain the vault"). Copied unchanged from the team site's data/person-keys.json, where the key was issued; the private half lives only in the person's browser. Sealed things on this site addressed to a person (ws-ecies-1) are sealed to the key here: newsroom/observability/sealed/<person>.json opens the observability vaults for them on /newsroom/observability/. Agents' keys are board/keys.json.
